Maximum tokens purchasable in one buy; derived from percent/divisor.

lockTheSwap function swapping tokens for ETH and transferring BNB to marketing wallet.

onlyOwner function recomputing _maxBuyAmount from percent/divisor with arithmetic.
onlyOwner function setting the cooldown duration in seconds.

Constructor minting full reflection supply, creating the pair and setting fee exclusions.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, transfer and allowance authorization.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for lock/unlock, cooldowns and router deadlines.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is added to the lock duration to set the unlock time, making the lock period miner-influenceable.
lock() writes _lockTime from block.timestamp + time, controlling later unlock gating.
The time parameter is consumed when computing the new lock expiry.
unlock() compares block.timestamp against _lockTime to release ownership, a timestamp dependency.
unlock() authorizes msg.sender against _previousOwner before restoring ownership.
_previousOwner is read to validate the caller and to restore ownership.
unlock() rewrites _owner, changing privileged access control state.
onlyOwner modifier authorizes msg.sender against _owner before blacklisting.
The account parameter is the key written into the blacklist mapping.
setBlacklistStatus writes _isBlacklisted for the supplied account.
The _cooldown parameter overwrites the cooldown state variable.
setCooldown mutates the cooldown duration used by _transfer.
The percent parameter feeds a mul/div computation that derives the max buy amount.
The divisor parameter is used as the divisor in the max buy amount computation.
setMaxBuyPercent computes local new_tx via mul/div arithmetic before validating it.
The locally computed new_tx is written into _maxBuyAmount without upper bound enforcement.
transfer() forwards _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
The recipient parameter flows into _transfer via transfer().
transfer() delegates its core logic to _transfer.
The from parameter is used to read and update reflection balances.
The to parameter is used to read and update reflection balances.
The amount parameter is passed to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer enforces buy/sell cooldowns and writes cooldown expiries using block.timestamp.
_transfer reads and updates the buycooldown mapping, gating purchases by timestamp.
_transfer requires both from and to to be non-blacklisted addresses.
_transfer reads inSwapAndLiquify to decide whether the automatic swap may run.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify mid-transfer, giving external calls an entry point into token accounting.
The locally computed contract token balance is passed as the amount to swapAndLiquify.
_transfer computes contractTokenBalance from balanceOf(address(this)).
_transfer derives the takeFee boolean from fee-exclusion mappings.
The takeFee boolean branches fee removal/restoration around the internal transfer.
The contractTokenBalance parameter is split into marketing and liquidity portions.
swapAndLiquify sends BNB to the marketing wallet, an external value transfer during swap state mutation.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity which performs an external payable router call.
The tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped by the router.
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the router deadline, a timestamp dependency.
swapTokensForEth performs an external swap call with zero minimum output, allowing value extraction.
The ethAmount parameter is forwarded as msg.value to addLiquidityETH.
addLiquidity uses block.timestamp as the router deadline.
addLiquidity routes the resulting LP tokens to owner(), tying liquidity to privileged ownership.
addLiquidity performs an external payable router call with zero slippage bounds.
amountPercentage scales the contract balance via mul/div before payout.
The local amountBNB is multiplied by the percentage and divided by 100.
clearStuckBalance is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
clearStuckBalance transfers BNB to the marketing wallet, an external value transfer.
The sender parameter is used for the transfer and allowance lookup.
The recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
The amount parameter is deducted from the allowance and passed to _transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
transferFrom delegates the token movement to _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom reads and writes _allowances for the spender.
The low-level call helper forwards all gas to an external address, enabling reentrancy callbacks into transfer logic.

normalization_plan.reason: The lock duration parameter has no independent security identity; it only feeds the lock() arithmetic yielding _lockTime.
The account parameter is a plain key written into the blacklist mapping; its semantics belong to setBlacklistStatus.
The cooldown value parameter only exists to overwrite the cooldown state variable in setCooldown.
The percentage parameter only parameterizes the owner-only BNB payout in clearStuckBalance.
The numerator parameter is only meaningful inside the setMaxBuyPercent arithmetic.
The divisor parameter is only meaningful inside the setMaxBuyPercent arithmetic.
The token balance parameter is only consumed by the swapAndLiquify split logic.
The token amount parameter is only used for approval and router swap in swapTokensForEth.
The ETH amount parameter is only forwarded as msg.value in addLiquidity.
The from parameter has no standalone security meaning; it drives the balance/blacklist logic of _transfer.
The to parameter has no standalone security meaning; it drives the balance/blacklist logic of _transfer.
The amount parameter is only consumed by the _transfer internal accounting.
The recipient parameter of the public transfer entrypoint is merged into transfer().
The sender parameter is only used by transferFrom for balance and allowance handling.
The recipient parameter is only forwarded by transferFrom into _transfer.
The amount parameter is only used by transferFrom for allowance subtraction and transfer.
The local balance is a temporary derived value inside _transfer that gates swapAndLiquify.
The takeFee boolean is a temporary decision variable inside _transfer's fee logic.
The new_tx local only holds the arithmetic result assigned to _maxBuyAmount in setMaxBuyPercent.
The amountBNB local only holds the contract balance used by clearStuckBalance's payout.
